description: This file defines the XfrmStat struct and functions to parse /proc/net/xfrm_stat for Linux kernel IPsec/Netfilter transformation statistics.

classes.name: XfrmStat
classes.description: Struct representing various IPsec/Netfilter transformation statistics read from /proc/net/xfrm_stat.

methods.name: NewXfrmStat
methods.description: Creates a new XfrmStat instance by reading /proc/net/xfrm_stat.

methods.name: NewXfrmStat (method)
methods.description: Reads /proc/net/xfrm_stat from the filesystem and populates an XfrmStat struct.
